frameFormat: [page, x, y, w, h, trimX, trimY, fullW, fullH]

kata_open_leg.note: Open Leg Stance (the kata ready stance) loop, 1.5 s: feet about shoulder width, toes turned out a little, knees soft, fists in front of the belt. Slow breathing; feet never move

stance_front.note: Front stance loop, 1.5 s: left foot forward, front knee over the ankle, back leg nearly straight with the back foot turned out, hips low. Lead fist forward, rear fist at the hip

stance_horse.note: Horse stance loop, 1.5 s: feet wide and parallel, knees bent and pushed out, hips sunk, back upright, fists chambered at the hips

stance_cat.note: Cat stance loop, 1.5 s: left foot forward resting on its ball with the heel up, nearly all the weight on the bent back leg, hips set back, forward guard

kata_low_block.note: Low Block: the left fist starts by the right ear, sweeps down and out to stop above the front knee; the right fist pulls to the hip
kata_low_block.side: left foot forward; mirror for the right side

kata_inside_block.note: Inside Block (outside to inside): the left fist starts up by the left ear and the forearm swings across to stop upright just past the right cheek, out in front of the face; the right fist pulls to the hip
kata_inside_block.side: left foot forward; mirror for the right side

kata_reverse_inside_block.note: Reverse Inside Block: the inside block (outside to inside) with the rear (right) hand while the left foot is forward; it stops just past the left cheek; the hips turn square, the left fist pulls to the hip
kata_reverse_inside_block.side: left foot forward; mirror for the right side

kata_high_block.note: High Block: the left forearm rises to slope up across the front of the face, elbow out and lower by the left cheek, fist higher just above the right eyebrow; the right fist pulls to the hip
kata_high_block.side: left foot forward; mirror for the right side

kata_punch.note: Punch: the left (front-side) fist drives from the hip to the middle of the chest while the right fist pulls back to the hip
kata_punch.side: left foot forward; mirror for the right side

kata_reverse_punch.note: Reverse Punch: the right (rear) fist drives to the middle while the hips turn square and the left fist pulls back to the hip
kata_reverse_punch.side: left foot forward; mirror for the right side

kata_backfist.note: Backfist: the left fist loads up at the right shoulder with the elbow up, then swings out, knuckles leading, to stop extended just outside the left cheek
kata_backfist.side: left foot forward; mirror for the right side

kata_spear_hand.note: Palm Down / Spear Hand: the right open hand presses down palm down to under the left elbow while the left open hand thrusts out at the solar plexus, palm down, fingers together
kata_spear_hand.side: left foot forward; mirror for the right side

kata_rear_leg_front_kick.side: left foot forward, the RIGHT leg kicks

travel.note: drawn centred: the hero starts 0.28 tiles behind the usual stance spot and ends 0.28 ahead; the standing foot never moves on the ground

kata_rear_leg_front_kick.note: Rear Leg Front Kick (right leg): hands catch at the right hip, the left foot stays planted, the right knee lifts high, the leg snaps out to the middle and back, then the right foot lands one step ahead (ends in a right front stance)

kata_rear_leg_front_kick_left.side: right foot forward, the LEFT leg kicks (a real left-leg render, not a flipped picture)

travel.note: drawn centred: the hero starts 0.28 tiles behind the usual stance spot and ends 0.28 ahead; the standing foot never moves on the ground

kata_rear_leg_front_kick_left.note: Rear Leg Front Kick (left leg): the same kick from a right front stance: hands catch at the left hip, the right foot stays planted, the left leg kicks and lands one step ahead (ends in a left front stance)

kata_front_kick_stacked.side: left foot forward, the RIGHT leg kicks

travel.note: drawn centred: the hero starts 0.28 tiles behind the usual stance spot and ends 0.28 ahead; the standing foot never moves on the ground

kata_front_kick_stacked.note: Rear Leg Front Kick, hands stacked (right leg): both fists stack one over the other at the right hip and stay there while the right leg chambers, kicks and lands one step ahead

kata_front_kick_stacked_left.side: right foot forward, the LEFT leg kicks (a real left-leg render, not a flipped picture)

travel.note: drawn centred: the hero starts 0.28 tiles behind the usual stance spot and ends 0.28 ahead; the standing foot never moves on the ground

kata_front_kick_stacked_left.note: Rear Leg Front Kick, hands stacked (left leg): both fists stack one over the other at the left hip and stay there while the left leg chambers, kicks and lands one step ahead

kata_break_hold.note: Break the Hold (David and Goliath step 2): from attention both open hands rise up the middle, cross in front of the chest and open out to the sides at head height, palms forward
kata_break_hold.side: left foot forward; mirror for the right side

kata_break_hold_finish.note: Break the Hold, David and Goliath step 12: the left foot draws in (heels together), both arms go up above the head, then drop sharply, the open hands crossing in front of the face, to finish palms down just outside the hips
kata_break_hold_finish.side: left foot forward; mirror for the right side

kata_special_turn.side: a real render, never mirrored: starts right foot forward (the kiai), ends left foot forward

turn.endFacing: 90 degrees clockwise on screen from the row's direction (row N ends facing E)
turn.note: offsets are tiles in the row's starting frame (right of and ahead of the way it faces at the start): the picture starts and ends that far from the hero's spot

kata_special_turn.note: Special turn (Basic Forms 1 and 2, after the kiai of steps 3 and 6): first the left (back) leg reaches behind to the rear right while the body still faces the kiai and the eyes look over the left shoulder; then the body spins a three-quarter turn to its left on the balls of the feet, the right foot swinging round to become the back foot, and the hero lands in a left front stance doing the Low Block

beltStyles.note: chosen belt style (belt revision, option C): tint per layer for each Action Zone belt (fixtures/); a layer that is not listed is not drawn (belt-center-edge is never drawn in this style). Tape stripes keep the belt.ts rule

palettes.note: Recommended swatches (hex), shown by the game in this order. They are multiply tints for the tinted layers (skin, hair-*, gi). Skin runs from light to deep. The ids in palettesDraftLabels are placeholders for the Content Writer, not names

groups.note: draw exactly one layer of each group, after the base layers (face, then hair)
